## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior. Link the issue when one exists.

## Changes

Explain the smallest complete fix and any public contract, schema, profile, or compatibility effect.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Identify unrun checks and remaining limits. Use sanitized output and synthetic inputs.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff is scoped; unrelated/concurrent work is preserved.
- [ ] Relevant callers, examples, documentation, and schemas are updated.
- [ ] Changed non-trivial behavior has a focused regression.
- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, tests, and the locked build pass, or a blocker is explained above.
- [ ] Query semantics, grounding boundaries, snapshot safety, and cleanup remain intact.
- [ ] Assurance claims remain bounded; external material has appropriate authorization and attribution.
- [ ] No credentials, tenant data, raw receipts, private operational data, or local handoff files are included.

## Risks and follow-up

State material risks and explicit nonblocking deferrals. Use “None identified” when appropriate.
